pr_title: Fix sorting of files/dirs in dialogs
pr_body:
Sorts leading `_` before all except `.`.

Optionally bound to scripting

Optionally added to `FileDialog` but can omit that if it's compatibility breaking

Added to a few places, think I've gotten all the places in the editor that handles files by ordering

The exact ordering can be further discussed, i.e. sorting `_` before just alphanumerics, etc., but keeping it relatively simple here

Based on how sorting is done in Windows file explorer (though in Powershell it sorts `_` after uppercase, so it depends, but I think it makes sense based on the reasons in the issue below)

* Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/87868

pr_comments:
This was originally intentional and done in:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/37796

Going with restoring the useful sorting here and unifying everything in this direction instead, the original sorting just used plain string comparisons, this now uses the new comparison setup, originally `FOO` would sort before `_foo` which was before `foo`

Keeping the case insensitive sorting that was already used

issue_context.title: Filesystem 4.x regression : Files/fodlers starting with "_" are displayed AFTER "a"/"z" instead of before as it works in other softwares (including Godot 3.X)
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in Godot v4.2.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.2.1.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 () - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-6700K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

In Godot 4.X, the filesystem now wrongly consider files/folders starting with an underscore \"_" should be displayed before files/folders starting with "a" or "z".

- This is a big issue because it prevents users to easily organize the files/folders by just adding \"_" before the files/folders we want to list first in their own folders.
- The workaround of renaming them "a\_" still doesn't work because for example "actions" would still be displayed before "a\_". So we need to do "aaaaaa_" instead, which is annoying to do and hurts readability
- An other issue with this is it means the order of files is different between Godot 4 and other softwares such as Windows Explorer, VSCode and even Godot 3 !

❌ The way it's currently displayed in Godot 4 ("\_" comes after "a" or any letter)

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/9054802/3cd9ccb2-8b7a-4154-8a7f-204e45cdc377)

✅ The way it should be displayed (as in Godot 3, Windows Explorer, VSCode, and almost any software)

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/9054802/39e11f6a-4fba-4e4b-bd43-e6876813a2c4)


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create several folders (or files)
2. Name one so it starts with an underscore "_"
3. The folder starting with "_" is displayed AFTER the other one starting with letters, while it should be displayed first

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[FileSystem_4.X_OrderIssue.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/14140758/FileSystem_4.X_OrderIssue.zip)
